east_catalysts_risks.notes:
In-window evidence is thin. Two in-window items have usable evidence: the Deccan Herald Bengaluru Business Corridor piece (1 Nov) and the Siasat Hoskote piece (31 Oct).

Caveats:
- Deccan Herald returned 403 on fetch. The BBC excerpts are quotes the search tool returned from the article and I could not open the page myself. The KRIDE Rs 511-crore item is headline-only, with no body, bidders or package detail, and its date is inferred only from the adjacent article ID.
- The Siasat piece conflicts with the 8 Oct Construction World report: 16.5 km vs 16.3 km for the Hoskote metro corridor. Both are proposals only, with the DPR still in preparation. The ADB funding approval is Siasat's wording and I could not corroborate it from a second source.
- The Bangalore Mirror STRR/Ramanagara lead could not be located, and Bangalore Mirror/TOI domains are blocked for the search tool. I found no price data for it and report nothing.
- The IndulgExpress Whitefield property piece and the TOI Bellandur Rajyotsava piece are lifestyle/cultural items with no catalyst or risk content, so I did not pursue them.
- No in-window news found on Varthur/Bellandur flooding, Sarjapur–Hebbal Phase 3A (central approval was reportedly expected around October 2026, unconfirmed), STRR, or Cauvery Stage VI.
- The Pink Line (Kalena Agrahara–Tavarekere, south Bengaluru) inauguration is awaiting a central date; reports of 29 Oct mention 15 Nov as a possibility. It is outside the East focus, so I did not include it as a claim.

east_launches_prices.notes: No project launches or new phases dated inside the window (30 Oct–2 Nov 2026) in East Bengaluru were found. The search tool surfaced mostly aggregator/developer-marketing pages with unreliable dates, and the Business Standard page returned 403. In-window items found: Siasat 31 Oct on Hoskote water (Rs 2,500 cr ADB-approved proposal; DPR stage) and the KR Puram–Hoskote metro hope. The IndulgExpress Whitefield lead is a lifestyle/hospitality piece that could not be found; the TOI Bellandur Rajyotsava lead is cultural, not market-relevant. Unverified signals from search snippets only (not fetched, so no claims or projects reported): MJR Divine Meadows Phase 2 (Sarjapur, 79 villas, RERA reportedly issued 23 Sep 2026), Sobha Sacred Grove plots (Chikkatirupati, RERA number reported by PropNewz), Abhee Hoskote plots, Godrej Row Villas Soukya Road (no RERA number on portal as of Aug 2026), and Puravankara Balagere/Sarjapur JDAs. These are candidates for a follow-up pass using developer sites and rera.karnataka.gov.in. No RERA numbers were checked on the portal.

government_watch.notes: Coverage is thin. Only the K-RIDE Corridor 4 ₹511 crore award (29 Oct LoA, reported 1 Nov) and the BDA skydeck/KPMG item (2 Nov) were confirmed inside the window. The skydeck item rests on a search-result summary, not a fetched page, because Deccan Herald returned 403. Not confirmed: Silk Board "Ward One" makeover (New Indian Express, Deccan Herald, Asianet, Urban Acres), GBA nine fire stations, ₹5 lakh crore urbanisation plan (NammaWard), GBA e-khata 62 centres, 43 Ward One wards, suburban rail ₹105.66 crore bridge contracts. Several of these showed up only as search-result headlines, so they are not reported as claims. thehindu.com could not be fetched. No in-window Karnataka cabinet, RERA, stamp-duty or court item was found. Godrej, Lodha, Puravankara and Hiranandani leads are outside Bengaluru government scope or are not Bengaluru-specific, so they were skipped. The PTI Ward One item was published 28 Oct, before the window, but its campaign start date of 1 Nov falls inside it. The search-result summary said ₹105.66 crore bridge letters went to ESSVY-SLNS on 30 Oct, which is unverified here.

metro_watch.notes: Window items found: K-RIDE Corridor 4 awards (LoA 29 Oct, reported 1 Nov), Pink Line CMRS clearance (28 Oct, reported 29 Oct, just before the window start of 30 Oct 06:00 IST, so treat as background for the inauguration-date story) and Blue Line trial-run expectation (28 Oct). Not verified: actual start of Blue Line trials; Pink Line inauguration date (15 Nov per CM, unconfirmed; 3 Nov not ruled out); kidney transport by metro (only an undated newsbytes snippet seen, not fetched); 31 Oct passenger-on-track disruption (only a listing, no article found); Trade Brains metro-expansion piece (not found). The Deccan Herald and bmrc.co.in/kride.in pages were not fetched (DH returned 403). Network length differs between sources (103.6 km total vs ~96 km base), so don't mix them. No fare, ridership or Phase 3/Red Line news dated in the window was found. Red Line background (2033 target, cost review) came from undated search snippets and is not reported as claims. The Sarjapur–Hebbal and Phase 3 items need a follow-up search.

social_signals.notes: No in-window (30 Oct–2 Nov 2026) social-media content found. Reddit and old.reddit were refused by the fetch tool. YouTube returned only a page footer, so no video listings were readable. LinkedIn returned HTTP 403 (login wall). Web searches returned no r/bangalore, YouTube or public LinkedIn URLs for the window. Results were developer and broker blogs, mostly undated or older. Two Teamblind threads (undated, not r/bangalore) surfaced and were not reported. The four claims above are background only: metro trial-run plans (15 and 19 Oct), a May 2026 Cushman & Wakefield launch-share figure, and an Aug 2026 broker price figure. None of them is social-media evidence, and no official source (BMRCL, K-RERA) confirmed anything new in the window. The BMRCL 15 Nov trial target is a stated plan, not an achieved milestone. Nothing was verified against rera.karnataka.gov.in. Valid result: nothing new found for social_signals in the window.
